# Compitiello & Donofrio Private Investigations (CAD PI)

> Discreet, trustworthy, and elite private investigation services led by former federal law enforcement supervisory special agents. Daily field operations centered in Maricopa County, with statewide Arizona coverage and nationwide federal network capabilities.

Compitiello & Donofrio Private Investigations (CAD PI) is an Arizona-licensed and bonded private investigative agency headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. The agency is founded and led by Michael Compitiello, a former Supervisory Special Agent with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security / Homeland Security Investigations (DHS/HSI) with over 25 years of federal law enforcement leadership and 35+ years of combined investigative experience.

## Key Resources
- [CAD Private Investigations Homepage](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com): Primary agency portal featuring investigative services, leadership profiles, client reviews, and direct case intake.
- [Confidential Case Consultation](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/#contact): Encrypted intake form and direct communication channels for legal counsel, corporate entities, and private clients.
- [Investigative Field Intelligence Archive](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/blog.html): Comprehensive archive of investigative case studies, federal methodologies, and Arizona statutory standards.
- [Privacy Policy & Compliance Terms](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/privacy-policy.html): Complete agency privacy disclosures, evidentiary data retention standards, and SMS communication terms.

## Core Investigative Services
- [Forensic Asset Tracing & Recovery](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/services/asset-tracing.html): Forensic tracing of hidden holdings, domestic shell LLCs, offshore corporate structures, and judgment enforcement support.
- [High-Net-Worth Divorce Asset Tracing](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/services/divorce-asset-investigations.html): Uncovering concealed marital wealth, undisclosed business revenues, offshore trusts, and marital dissipation for equitable distribution under Arizona Rule 49.
- [Judgment Enforcement & Creditor Asset Recovery](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/services/judgment-enforcement-asset-recovery.html): Locating attachable bank accounts, unencumbered real property, alter-ego corporate shells, and proving fraudulent transfers under the UVTA and UEFJA.
- [Business Partner Vetting & Commercial Due Diligence](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/services/business-partner-asset-due-diligence.html): Pre-venture due diligence, executive background vetting, and asset verification before joint ventures, acquisitions, or capital commitments.
- [Corporate Due Diligence & Vetting](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/services/corporate-vetting.html): Pre-transaction intelligence, executive background profiling, vendor risk mitigation, and corporate liability analysis.
- [Physical & Technical Surveillance](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/services/surveillance.html): High-definition, court-admissible surveillance for family law, infidelity verification, insurance SIU defense, and civil litigation.
- [Digital Forensics & Incident Response](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/services/digital-forensics.html): Computer forensics, trade secret theft investigation, mobile device analysis, and court-admissible digital evidence preservation.
- [Federal Litigation Support](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/#services): Evidentiary gathering, trial prep, chain of custody management, and expert testimony led by former federal law enforcement supervisory special agents.

## Investigative Dispatches & Analysis
- [Tracing Hidden Assets & Offshore Corporate Shells in High-Stakes Disputes](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/blog/tracing-hidden-assets-offshore-structures.html): Analysis of domestic privacy LLCs (Wyoming, Delaware, Nevada), offshore trusts, and correspondent banking SWIFT tracing.
- [Arizona Surveillance Law: Evidentiary Admissibility in Maricopa County Courts](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/blog/arizona-surveillance-law-admissibility-standards.html): Examination of A.R.S. § 13-3005 (one-party consent), A.R.S. § 13-3019 (reasonable expectation of privacy), and GPS vehicle tracking rules.
- [Red Flags in Corporate Mergers: Vetting Beneficial Ownership Beyond the Balance Sheet](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/blog/corporate-mergers-due-diligence-red-flags.html): Pre-transaction due diligence uncovering jurisdictional charter migration, circular related-party vendor payments, and unindexed court records.
- [Uncovering Insider Data Exfiltration: Digital Forensics in Corporate Trade Secret Theft](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/blog/digital-forensics-insider-threat-data-theft.html): Forensic extraction of Windows USB registry hives, LNK shortcuts, and Shellbags artifacts to secure emergency Temporary Restraining Orders (TROs).

## Leadership & Credentials
- [Michael Compitiello - Founder & Director](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/#leadership): Former DHS/HSI Supervisory Special Agent with 25+ years of federal law enforcement leadership and 35+ years of combined investigative experience. Recipient of the HSI Director's Award for Excellence in Investigations and INS Commissioner's Award.
- [John Donofrio - Operations Manager](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/#leadership): Licensed Arizona Private Investigator managing daily Maricopa County field operations, surveillance coordination, and client relations.

## Practice Focus Areas
- [Attorneys & Law Firms Practice Overview](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/#services): Family law, criminal defense, civil litigation, and corporate counsel requiring court-admissible evidence and expert witness testimony.
- [Corporations & Enterprises Due Diligence](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/#services): Executive leadership, HR departments, and risk managers seeking due diligence, fraud investigation, and internal theft resolution.
- [High-Net-Worth Individuals & Family Office Advisory](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/#contact): Private clients seeking confidential background vetting, domestic investigations, infidelity inquiries, or missing person location.
- [Insurance Special Investigations Units (SIU)](https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/#services): Special investigations units and defense counsel investigating fraudulent claims and liability disputes.
